resources.string: QuicLoc uses Device Admin only to lock the screen when your find-my-phone passphrase is triggered. It cannot wipe data, change your PIN, prevent uninstall, or access any other admin capability. You can revoke this at any time in Settings → Security → Device admin apps.

For the find-my-phone passphrase to actually lock the device (instead of just covering the screen), QuicLoc needs Device Admin rights.

What this allows:
• Locking the screen when your passphrase trigger fires

What this does NOT allow:
• Wiping your data — never requested
• Changing your PIN or password — never requested
• Preventing app uninstall — never requested
• Reading or tracking anything else

You can revoke this at any time in Settings → Security → Device admin apps. The next screen is the standard Android grant dialog.
